image_description: A close-up, high-angle shot of a white hamster sitting inside a bright green plastic bowl or container. The hamster is facing forward, with its front paws resting on the rim. The lighting is somewhat dim with a flash reflection, creating shadows in the background. A blue object (possibly a shoe) is visible in the bottom right corner.

Two distinct, small, black bead-like eyes are clearly visible and symmetrically placed.
Both ears are visible, appearing rounded and proportionate to the head size, consistent with hamster anatomy.

checkpoint_verdicts.checkpoint: Dense short fur in golden, brown, black, or white coloration.
checkpoint_verdicts.reasoning: The fur is white, dense, and appears short/fluffy, matching the texture and color criteria.

The rear of the hamster is hidden inside the bowl; the tail is not visible.
